question: Should inference/cloudflare-workers-ai state the embedding and rerank share of the 10,000 Neurons a day?
why: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ prices @cf/baai/bge-m3 at 1075 neurons per M input tokens and @cf/baai/bge-reranker-base at 283 neurons per M input tokens; 10,000 Neurons / 1075 = about 9.3M bge-m3 input tokens a day and 10,000 / 283 = about 35.3M reranker input tokens a day (derived, one model at a time, no card on the Free plan per the record).
